name: FloPlast 110mm Anthracite Grey Soil Pipe Strap on Pipe Connector
description: The FloPlast Soil Pipe Strap on Pipe Connector allows you to add a waste pipe to a soil system without the use of a fitting. Simple calculate the point at which you want the waste pipe to enter the soil pipe, cut a hole in the pipe using a 54-56mm hole cutter and locate strap boss. For extra protection you use either silicone or solvent cement around the hole to avoid any potential leaks. Once located fit the appropriate adaptor it will allow 32mm, 40mm and 50mm waste pipes to be connected to the soil stack.
